title: Red panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#FF4FA3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#7DF9FF'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='26' x2='58' y2='26' stroke='#7DF9FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#F5C6A5'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#F5C6A5'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='27' ry='24' fill='#E8753A'/>
  <!-- White face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='54' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#FFF5E6'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='54' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#FFF5E6'/>

  <circle cx='39.5' cy='50.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='50.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3A1F0E'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 64 Q50 68 54 64' stroke='#3A1F0E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='24' y1='56' x2='14' y2='53' stroke='#FFF5E6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='60' x2='13' y2='60' stroke='#FFF5E6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='56' x2='86' y2='53' stroke='#FFF5E6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='60' x2='87' y2='60' stroke='#FFF5E6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#B5451C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#FFF5E6'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3A1F0E'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3A1F0E'/>
